description: Per-file review checklists derived from skills/codeReview/instructions: one JSON per reviewed file of skills/codeReview/test-environment (its README.md is documentation, not a reviewed file) and one per file kind the instructions describe that the environment lacks. Each JSON carries the full text of every checklist item that file must satisfy, chosen by the file's real role and content — not by the global/local split, applies-to patterns or scope tags.

conventions.itemId: `<instruction>#<n>`: n is the item's position in the source checklist, the same address a review report uses.
conventions.text: The item text as written in the source, without its scope tag; `{{…}}` placeholders are left as written.
conventions.preamble: The instruction's own paragraphs before its checklist (ownership, severity, scope), when it has any.
conventions.gate: The instruction's applicability condition from its frontmatter, copied as is.
conventions.selectedItems: The selected item numbers in range form; checklistSize is the size of the full source checklist.
conventions.order: In every file the instructions specific to its kind come first, the cross-cutting ones last.

instructions.name: Code quality — duplication, dead code, boilerplate & consistency
Test coverage — untested cases & edge cases

excluded.reason: `audience: implement` — it binds code writing, not review, and has no checklist; the details of its canonical component shape that the review enforces are component#3, component#8 and component-styles#3.
